title: tc-activity-calendar
description:
A year of activity, a square per day in a column per week, shaded by how much happened – with month and weekday
names, a total, and the day's value on hover or focus.

heading.description: The heading, and the grid's name

days.description: The days with activity, in any order; a day not listed counts as 0

end.description: The last day shown, as epoch ms of any moment in it; by default the latest day in `days`

weeks.description: How many weeks to show, ending with the week of `end`

weekStart.description: The first day of the week, as the first row: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday … 6 Saturday

max.description: The value that shades a day fully; by default the busiest day shown

levels.description: How many shades, counting empty: 5 is empty and four steps of activity

unit.description: What the values count, after the number: "12 events"

selected.description: The selected day, as epoch ms of its local midnight. Changed by the user unless a tc-selected-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for month, weekday and number names, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

date.description: The day, as epoch ms of any moment in it (local time)

value.description: How much happened; null means no data for the day
